plan.title: Fix kanban-merge to mark task done BEFORE merging
plan.overview: Reorder steps in the kanban-merge skill to update task status to "done" and commit while still on the task branch, before checking out main and merging. This ensures the status change commit is part of the task branch history, not an extra commit on main.

approach.rationale:
The current step order is: 1. merge_branch (checkout main, merge task branch) 2. cleanup_branch (delete task branch) 3. move_to_done_and_commit (update status, commit on main)
The fix reorders to: 1. move_to_done_and_commit (update status, commit on task branch) - BEFORE checkout main 2. merge_branch (checkout main, merge task branch) 3. cleanup_branch (delete task branch)
This is a pure step reorder with no logic changes. The skill uses independent XML step blocks that can be safely reordered. The key constraint from spec research is that branch deletion must remain after merge (cannot delete a branch we're merging from).
approach.breaking-changes: None - internal skill step reorder only

task.name: Reorder steps in kanban-merge skill
task.action:
Move the `move_to_done_and_commit` step (lines 118-126) to BEFORE the `merge_branch` step.
Current order at lines 108-126: ```xml <step name="merge_branch"> <command>git checkout main</command> <command>git merge task/{taskId} --no-ff -m "Merge branch 'task/{taskId}'"</command> <note>Use `--no-ff` to preserve branch history</note> </step>
<step name="cleanup_branch"> <command>git branch -d task/{taskId}</command> </step>
<step name="move_to_done_and_commit"> ... </step> ```
New order: ```xml <step name="move_to_done_and_commit"> <note>Format: `docs({taskId}): done - {title}`</note> <action>Change `status: pr` to `status: done`</action> <action>Add `updated: {YYYY-MM-DD}`</action> <action>Add `completed: {YYYY-MM-DD}`</action> <action>Write updated task file</action> <command>git add .kanban/tasks/{taskId}/task.xml</command> <command>git commit -m "docs({taskId}): done - {title}"</command> </step>
<step name="merge_branch"> <command>git checkout main</command> <command>git merge task/{taskId} --no-ff -m "Merge branch 'task/{taskId}'"</command> <note>Use `--no-ff` to preserve branch history</note> </step>
<step name="cleanup_branch"> <command>git branch -d task/{taskId}</command> </step> ```
task.verify: Grep for step names to confirm order: move_to_done_and_commit appears before merge_branch
task.done: Steps are reordered so status update happens before checkout main
